blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The first batch of 230 public school personnel has received scholarships to undergo the Learning Initiatives for Nurturing Guidance Associates and Counselors Program (Lingap), which will prepare them to fill the nationwide shortage of school mental health professionals. The scholarships for the program are a joint initiative of the Department of Education (DepEd) and the Commission on Higher Education (CHED) to support the graduate education and professional development of DepEd personnel in guidance, counseling, and psychology so that they can fill the gap in licensed mental health professionals in basic education.
